artworks.title: The Consequences of War
artworks.description: Rubens' Palatina allegory unleashes Alecto among the wreckage of Europe: the Fury torches the arts while Mars strides through — Virgil's unforgetting Erinys remade as a Baroque indictment of war.

artworks.title: Orestes Pursued by the Furies
artworks.description: Bouguereau's Academic nightmare packs the Erinyes around the matricide — Alecto among the sisters whose names Apollodorus and Hyginus list as the unforgetting punishers of blood-guilt.

artworks.title: The Erinyes
artworks.description: Vázquez paints the Furies as a Spanish Mannerist trio — Alecto, Tisiphone and Megaera as winged tormentors, the named Erinyes of the later mythographic lists.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: In Aeneid 7 Juno summons Alecto from the Underworld to poison Amata and Turnus — the Fury whose torch and snakes turn Latium into war.

popCulture.title: Hades
popCulture.creator: Supergiant Games
popCulture.description: Supergiant's underworld roguelike keeps Alecto among the Fury sisters who guard the House — the unforgetting Erinys as a boss of rage and whip.

popCulture.title: Alecto
popCulture.description: One of the three named Erinyes — the Fury 'who never rests,' partner to Tisiphone and Megaera in Apollodorus and Hyginus.
